meta.name: State GSDP and NSDP, 2011-12 base, series 2011-12 onward
meta.source_org: Ministry of Statistics and Programme Implementation (MoSPI), National Accounts Statistics; RBI Handbook of Statistics on Indian States (via dbie.rbihub.in)
meta.limitations: Base year 2011-12. Constant-price fields are at 2011-12 prices. The MoSPI API has no GSDP or NSDP for Assam, Haryana, Nagaland, Ladakh, Dadra and Nagar Haveli and Daman and Diu, and Lakshadweep; RBI fills NSDP (not GSDP) for Assam, Haryana, Nagaland in separate *_rbi fields. Latest years are advance estimates and later years can change. Telangana exists from 2014 but the source gives it for 2011-12 on (back-cast). Series before 2011-12 use another base (2004-05) and are not included.
meta.method: Rows are (state, financial year). year = first calendar year of the financial year (2011 = 2011-12). Values are copied from the source without change. MoSPI fields and RBI fields stay in separate columns because the vintages differ.
meta.redistributed_via: RBI DBIE hub web pages for the *_rbi columns
